items.title: Dave Robinson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2007
items.q: people give lip service to Louis Armstrong, but you know what, they’re not really out there

ctx.x: But people would have said that about Armstrong in the twenties and thirties. Armstrong is I guess kind of an exception because he had his centennial a few years back and there was a lot of attention devoted to him and you hear a lot of — people give lip service to Louis Armstrong, but you know what, they’re not really out there — educators I’m talking about — they’re not really out there teaching what Armstrong did or encouraging their students to try playing within that idiom. I mean it’s sort of fashionable to…
Can you pinpoint what’s the major difference between those traditional jazz styles? Is it in the rhythm section or is it in the horn ensemble playing?
